pages.title: Moonlit Potting Shed
pages.concept: Illustrated title cover introducing the moonlit potting-shed garden theme.
pages.artwork_description: A rustic potting bench spans the lower half of the page beneath an arched shed window. A carved pumpkin lantern sits centrally among herb jars, seed packets, terracotta pots, hand tools and trailing vines. Through the window, a full moon hangs above an enclosed walled kitchen garden with climbing plants and distant pumpkins. A vintage seed-packet label at the top carries the title, with a small subtitle beneath.
pages.generation_prompt: Cover artwork: rustic potting bench across the lower half beneath an arched shed window opening onto a moonlit walled kitchen garden; central carved pumpkin lantern, herb jars, tied herb bundles, seed packets, terracotta pots, trowel, secateurs and trailing vines; full moon and garden wall visible through window; vintage seed-packet label with exact title text “MOONLIT POTTING SHED” and small subtitle “AUTUMN GARDEN MAGIC TO COLOUR”.
pages.production_notes: Verify title and subtitle exactly. Keep the seed-packet label open and readable. Cover is included as a colourable illustrated page; retain broad spaces on pumpkin, pots, bench boards and window sky. Printing note: print single-sided at 100% scale on A4 or US Letter; do not fit-to-page if it clips the safe border.

pages.title: The Lantern Bench
pages.concept: A welcoming potting-bench still life with the pumpkin lantern as the focal object.
pages.artwork_description: A carved pumpkin lantern rests on a worn wooden potting bench, framed by three labelled herb jars, two small seed packets, a watering can, a trowel and a pair of gardening gloves. Above, an arched window shows a full moon, sparse clouds and curling vine silhouettes. Below the bench are three stacked terracotta pots and a basket of fallen leaves.
pages.generation_prompt: Colouring page titled “THE LANTERN BENCH”; central carved pumpkin lantern on a weathered wooden potting bench; exactly three herb jars, exactly two seed packets, watering can, trowel and gardening gloves arranged around it; arched window above with full moon, sparse clouds and curling vines; exactly three stacked terracotta pots and a basket of autumn leaves beneath the bench.
pages.production_notes: Check exactly 3 herb jars, 2 seed packets and 3 stacked pots. Ensure the pumpkin face is friendly and non-threatening. Maintain open colourable areas in the wood grain, pumpkin, watering can and pots.

pages.title: Herbs by Moonlight
pages.concept: A botanical hanging-herb composition with a quiet magical garden view.
pages.artwork_description: Six distinct bundles of garden herbs hang from an ornate iron rail: rosemary, sage, thyme, lavender, mint and chamomile. Each bundle is tied with a ribbon and has recognisable leaf or flower shapes. Behind them, an arched window frames the moon, a garden wall and climbing ivy. A narrow shelf below holds three simple ceramic jars and a small crescent-moon charm.
pages.generation_prompt: Colouring page titled “HERBS BY MOONLIGHT”; ornate wrought-iron hanging rail holding exactly six tied herb bundles: rosemary, sage, thyme, lavender, mint and chamomile, each visually distinct; arched window behind with full moon, enclosed garden wall and climbing ivy; narrow shelf below with exactly three ceramic jars and one small crescent-moon charm.
pages.production_notes: Check there are exactly 6 herb bundles and 3 jars. Botanical forms should be recognisable without relying on tiny labels. Keep herbs detailed but with enough leaf interiors to colour.

pages.title: Pumpkin Patch Gate
pages.concept: An inviting enclosed garden gate leading to a neat pumpkin patch.
pages.instructions: Colour the garden beyond the gate.
pages.artwork_description: An open wrought-iron gate stands centrally in a brick-and-stone garden wall. A winding flagstone path leads through the gate to a moonlit pumpkin patch containing seven pumpkins of different sizes. Tall hollyhocks, ivy and curling squash vines frame the gate, while a small lantern hangs from the arch overhead. The full moon sits in open sky beyond.
pages.generation_prompt: Colouring page titled “PUMPKIN PATCH GATE”; central open wrought-iron gate in an old brick-and-stone walled garden, winding flagstone path beyond; exactly seven pumpkins in the moonlit patch, all clearly countable and varied in size; hollyhocks, ivy and curling squash vines framing the gate; one hanging lantern above and a full moon in open sky.
pages.production_notes: Check exactly 7 pumpkins are visible beyond the gate, with no ambiguous partial extra pumpkins. Preserve broad path stones, wall sections and sky for resting space.

pages.title: Seed Packet Cabinet
pages.concept: A cosy apothecary-style cabinet of seasonal seeds and garden keepsakes.
pages.artwork_description: A shallow wooden cabinet with nine square compartments fills the page. The compartments contain: a pumpkin seed packet, a calendula seed packet, a sweet pea seed packet, a rosemary seed packet, a packet of mixed autumn leaves, a small ceramic bird, a spool of twine, a folded garden map and a tiny glass bottle holding acorns. Decorative vines curl lightly around the cabinet corners.
pages.generation_prompt: Colouring page titled “SEED PACKET CABINET”; front-facing shallow wooden cabinet divided into exactly nine square compartments; contents, one per compartment: pumpkin seed packet, calendula seed packet, sweet pea seed packet, rosemary seed packet, mixed autumn leaves, small ceramic bird, spool of twine, folded garden map, tiny glass bottle holding acorns; decorative corner vines. Seed packet labels use only short clear words: “PUMPKIN”, “CALENDULA”, “SWEET PEA”, “ROSEMARY”.
pages.production_notes: Check exactly 9 compartments and listed contents. Verify the four short packet labels; remove labels if malformed rather than retaining incorrect text. Avoid overly small wording.

pages.title: Moonflower Trellis
pages.concept: A serene trellis study of night-blooming flowers, vines and garden tools.
pages.artwork_description: A tall wooden trellis forms the main composition, covered in large open moonflower blooms, heart-shaped leaves and spiralling tendrils. A crescent-shaped hand rake and a small hand fork hang neatly from two hooks. At the base, two terracotta pots, a snail and a cluster of three mushrooms sit among fallen leaves. The upper background remains lightly open with a small moon peeking through leaves.
pages.generation_prompt: Colouring page titled “MOONFLOWER TRELLIS”; tall wooden garden trellis covered with large open moonflower blooms, heart-shaped leaves and spiralling tendrils; exactly two hanging tools, a crescent-shaped hand rake and a hand fork; at base exactly two terracotta pots, one snail and exactly three mushrooms among fallen leaves; small moon peeking through upper foliage.
pages.production_notes: Check exactly 2 hanging tools, 2 pots and 3 mushrooms. Use large flower petals and leaf interiors for colourability; prevent the trellis grid from becoming visually cramped.

pages.title: Harvest Tea in the Shed
pages.concept: A peaceful domestic still life of a gardener's evening tea break.
pages.artwork_description: A round wooden table inside the potting shed holds a floral teapot, two mismatched cups, a plate with four biscuits, a small pumpkin, a sprig-filled vase and an open gardening journal. A checked cloth drapes over one edge. Behind the table, shelves hold jars and pots, while an arched window reveals a moon and garden silhouettes. A stool tucked under the table has a curled sleeping cat beneath it.
pages.generation_prompt: Colouring page titled “HARVEST TEA IN THE SHED”; round wooden table with floral teapot, exactly two mismatched cups, plate holding exactly four biscuits, one small pumpkin, sprig-filled vase and open gardening journal; checked cloth draped over edge; shelves with jars and pots behind; arched window with moon and garden silhouettes; stool beneath table and one curled sleeping cat under the stool.
pages.production_notes: Check exactly 2 cups, 4 biscuits, 1 small pumpkin and 1 cat. Keep journal pages free of tiny illegible writing; use simple line suggestions only.

pages.title: The Friendly Scarecrow
pages.concept: A gentle, non-scary garden guardian surrounded by autumn produce.
pages.artwork_description: A smiling scarecrow with a patched hat, buttoned coat and straw hands stands in the centre of a tidy kitchen garden. It holds a small lantern in one hand and a bunch of carrots in the other. Around its feet are five pumpkins, a wheelbarrow of leaves, a low picket fence and curling bean vines. A crescent moon and a few small stars appear in the open upper sky.
pages.generation_prompt: Colouring page titled “THE FRIENDLY SCARECROW”; gentle smiling scarecrow in patched hat and buttoned coat, straw hands, holding one small lantern and one bunch of carrots; tidy kitchen garden setting with exactly five pumpkins around its feet, wheelbarrow filled with leaves, low picket fence and curling bean vines; crescent moon with a few small stars in upper sky.
pages.production_notes: Check exactly 5 pumpkins, one lantern and one carrot bunch. Keep expression warm, peaceful and clearly non-frightening. Ensure hat, coat patches, pumpkins and wheelbarrow offer broad colouring areas.

pages.title: Garden Ghost's Delivery
pages.concept: A whimsical, friendly ghost brings seasonal seeds to the potting shed.
pages.artwork_description: A small smiling ghost floats gently beside a potting-shed door, carrying a wicker basket filled with three seed packets and two tiny pumpkins. The ghost wears no costume details beyond a simple scalloped sheet outline. A black cat sits on the doorstep, and a lantern, broom, potted chrysanthemum and climbing ivy decorate the doorway. In the background, a moonlit garden wall and bare branches create a quiet night setting.
pages.generation_prompt: Colouring page titled “GARDEN GHOST’S DELIVERY”; one small friendly smiling ghost with a simple scalloped sheet outline floating beside a potting-shed door, carrying wicker basket containing exactly three seed packets and exactly two tiny pumpkins; one black-cat-shaped cat sitting on doorstep, lantern, broom, potted chrysanthemum and climbing ivy around door; moonlit garden wall and bare branches behind.
pages.production_notes: Check exactly 1 ghost, 3 seed packets, 2 tiny pumpkins and 1 cat. The cat must be outlined only, with no solid black fill. Keep the ghost simple, kind and not frightening.

pages.title: Full Moon Garden Finale
pages.concept: A richly detailed but calm closing panorama of the complete walled garden.
pages.artwork_description: A wide view of the enclosed kitchen garden under a large full moon. A central stone birdbath is surrounded by four pumpkin lanterns, mixed autumn flowers and curling squash vines. To the left stands the potting shed with its arched window; to the right, a wrought-iron bench sits beneath an apple tree with five hanging apples. Garden paths, brick walls, potted herbs and distant bats complete the peaceful finale.
pages.generation_prompt: Colouring page titled “FULL MOON GARDEN FINALE”; enclosed moonlit kitchen garden panorama with large full moon overhead; central stone birdbath surrounded by exactly four carved pumpkin lanterns, autumn flowers and curling squash vines; potting shed with arched window on left; wrought-iron bench beneath apple tree on right with exactly five hanging apples; garden paths, brick walls, potted herbs and exactly three distant small bats.
pages.production_notes: Check exactly 4 pumpkin lanterns, 5 apples and 3 bats. Bats should be tiny decorative silhouettes outlined without solid fill. Retain generous colourable sky, path, wall and foliage sections for a satisfying final page.
